debug.description: Enable debug logging for all Charliecloud commands.

build_dir.description: Path to the image build directory (build cache). If empty, defaults to ~/.local/share/charliecloud/build.

cache_dir.description: Path to the image cache directory (used by ch-image). If empty, defaults to ~/.local/share/charliecloud/cache.

image_dir.description: Path to the image directory (where images are built and stored). If empty, defaults to ~/.local/share/charliecloud/images.

tmp_dir.description: Path to the temporary directory. If empty, defaults to system temp directory (TMPDIR env var or /tmp).

no_cache.description: Disable use of the build cache (always rebuild from scratch).

jobs.description: Maximum number of concurrent build jobs.

bind_mounts.description: List of bind mounts to inject into containers. Format: host_path:container_path[:options].

env_forward.description: List of environment variables to forward from host to container. Variable names only (no values).

enable_userns.description: Enable user namespace mapping (required for unprivileged operation).

fallback_builder.description: Path to the fallback image builder (e.g., Docker). If empty, defaults to 'docker'.

enable_fallback.description: Enable use of fallback builder (Docker) when building fails with native builder.

strict.description: Enable strict mode: fail on warnings and non-zero exit codes.

shell.description: Default shell for ch-run (e.g., /bin/bash). If empty, defaults to /bin/sh.

no_overlay.description: Disable use of overlay filesystems for writable layers.

overlay_dir.description: Path to the overlay directory (for persistent overlays). If empty, defaults to ~/.local/share/charliecloud/overlay.

enable_run_user.description: Enable use of /run/user for sockets and temp files.

fallback_run_user.description: Enable use of /tmp instead of /run/user if /run/user is unavailable.
